remarks: Newly Reduced ! Available (furnished or unfurnished)! Discover this move-in-ready one-bedroom condo perfectly situated in the heart of Downtown Stamford. Just steps outside your door, you'll find Stamford's top restaurants, shops, and public transportation, making everyday living, commuting, and entertainment effortless.  An unbeatable location-come see it for yourself! Available for furnished at $2500/month
